analysis.title: GS Lucas - GS ETF Color charts bullets 30 Sep 2026
key_insights: More than $1.5 trillion has flowed into ETFs in 2026, passing last year's record annual total in three quarters. That is about $167 billion a month and about $8 billion a session.
GS expects US ETF flows to exceed $2 trillion in 2026, citing the current pace and seasonal Q4 tailwinds.

SPX is on track to outperform RTY for 7 straight weeks, the longest streak since 2018. XLK is outperforming SPX for 6 straight weeks. Mega caps are driving the support and demand is moving toward concentrated exposures.
MAGS has taken in inflows on 12 of the past 13 sessions, one of its longest stretches of recurring demand since launch.
RSP is on track for 7 consecutive weekly declines, which would tie its longest losing stretch. The desk reads this as support at the top of the market cap spectrum.
AI-driven demand for cybersecurity exposure has the ETF group on track for one of its best months of inflows in the desk's dataset (+$950mm).
TLT hit an all-time low this week in its roughly 25 years of history, and is on track for losses over 7 consecutive sessions, its longest daily losing streak in 2 years.
Muni bond ETFs are collectively tracking one of their worst months of index performance in 20 years, yet inflows continue, supported by tax loss harvesting rotations.
Spot-bitcoin ETFs have registered 9 consecutive days of inflows totaling more than $3 billion, the largest 9-day haul YTD. Over $6 billion has entered the group over the past two months.
ETF trading volume rises with market volatility. As the 10yr yield pushed through 5% this month, fixed income ETF trading volumes accelerated rapidly.

sector_views.rationale: XLK has outperformed SPX for 6 straight weeks, with mega caps providing much of the market's support.
AI-fueled demand has the cybersecurity ETF group on track for one of its best months of inflows in the dataset (+$950mm).

macro_indicators.interpretation: The 10yr pushed through 5% this month, and fixed income ETF trading volumes accelerated as rates rose.
GS expects full-year US ETF flows to exceed $2 trillion, up from the $1.5 trillion already collected through three quarters.

crypto_views: Spot-bitcoin ETFs have had 9 consecutive days of inflows totaling more than $3 billion, the largest 9-day haul YTD.
More than $6 billion has flowed into spot-bitcoin ETFs over the past two months, so demand extends beyond the last two weeks.
risk_factors: The 10yr yield is above 5% and TLT is at an all-time low with a 7-session losing streak.
Muni bond ETFs are on track for one of their worst months of index performance in 20 years.
Market leadership is narrow and concentrated in mega caps, and equal-weight RSP is on track for 7 straight weekly declines.
vol_and_positioning: ETF trading activity rises as volatility rises, and the same pattern appeared with the recent rise in rates. Fixed income ETF volumes accelerated as the 10yr moved through 5%.
SPX is on track for 7 straight weeks of outperformance over RTY, and RSP is on track for 7 straight weekly declines. Positioning is concentrated in mega caps.
MAGS has seen inflows on 12 of the past 13 sessions.
